title: bibliograph-mcp: one MCP server for scholarly search with typed envelopes and query receipts
description: One Model Context Protocol server for scholarly search, Japan and Korea first: NDL Search and Digital Collections full text, the WARP web archive, CiNii Research, J-STAGE, JDCat, KCI and Open Access Korea, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref and Japanese name and authority resolution, answering with one typed JSON envelope and depositing hash-chained query receipts to one ledger. From 2.0.0 one server in one process; 1.x installed six separate servers at pinned tags.
